method_limits.php_substages: NOT individually timed — no Server-Timing headers. Bootstrap/controller/RBAC/menu/sidebar/view collapse into document TTFB.
method_limits.usable_ms_bias: Harness waits for ~600ms network quiet after load — inflates usable_ms vs FCP/DCL. Prefer TTFB/DCL/FCP for root cause.

exact_root_cause_online.primary: Every left-nav click is a FULL document navigation. Soft-online SW is network-first (pos-sw.js navigateErpCloudWithCacheSafety), so HTML is regenerated by PHP and re-downloaded (~80–100KB, TTFB ~370–470ms) on BOTH cold and warm visits to the same URL.
exact_root_cause_online.secondary_first_click_only: First visit to a module pulls module-specific JS over network (e.g. HR: table-tools, module-page-stats, rateb-date-inputs, rateb-bulk-delete). Cold JS resource time 1027ms → warm 201ms (Δ≈826ms). That is the measurable first-vs-second gap when shared CSS/JS already cached.
not_the_cause: Same-URL HTML cache hit online (transferSize stays full every time)

exact_root_cause_offline.primary_cached_modules: Document TTFB is tiny (1–15ms from Cache Storage) but every nav still re-parses ~86–100KB HTML and re-executes cached JS (offline JS totals often 500–1460ms). Full document reload, not SPA.
exact_root_cause_offline.primary_uncached_modules: CRM/finance/payroll/projects/documents/assets/website often still miss ops-page cache → uncachedAdminBrowseResponse (~1.2KB) with elevated SW miss TTFB (~200–450ms).

online_summary.interpretation: Average cold≈warm usable — HTML path does not get faster on second click. Modules with new JS (HR Δ usable 302ms) show the asset cold tax.

offline_summary.interpretation: Offline is slow because of full document + JS re-exec (cached) or thin miss (uncached), not PHP.

server_curl_origin_ttfb.note: curl from production host to https://rateb.sa (opaque PHP wall; no stage split)
server_curl_origin_ttfb.interpretation: Origin PHP can be 1.5–1.7s; CRM shows strong second-hit drop (1579→117). Browser Navigation Timing TTFB ~400ms is lower (edge/protocol) but still dominated by server HTML generation every click.
